meaning: Successful transaction (approved / successfully processed / settled manual review) — captured/authorised; fulfil after /status + amount check
Successful transaction flagged for review — money moved; review (fraud/AVS/CVV suspicion) before fulfilment
Pending short-term — session open; ~30 min then timeout; 000.200.000 pending, 000.200.100 created, 000.200.201 QR/link opened
Pending delayed finalisation — non-instant methods (debit orders, async EFT); can take days — do NOT retry
Requires shopper action — SCA soft-decline (300.100.100) or timeout (900.100.3xx/4xx); retry through 3DS or challengeIndicator=04
Cancelled by shopper / uncertain — map to canceled so late out-of-order webhooks never downgrade a confirmed order
Chargeback / reversal family (000.100.200–000.100.234 + 000.100.299) — dispute/reversal, NOT a successful capture; fail closed to error
Intermediate 3DS-step codes (000.400.101 card not participating / 000.400.102 user not enrolled), NOT success — the debit's own terminal code decides
3-D Secure authentication-step rejections (100.390.100–124; PARes/enrolment/challenge/fraud); decline, never success — shopper should retry or use another method
Communication error band (000.400.03x) — network or timeout issue, often retryable
